blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.17
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.17

blocks.text: वितर्क आत्मज्ञानम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] वितर्क आत्मज्ञानम्

blocks.text: Vitarka ātmajñānam.
blocks.directed: Vitarka ātmajñānam.

blocks.text: Reflective ascertainment is knowledge of the Self.
blocks.directed: Reflective ascertainment is knowledge of the Self.

blocks.text: Your New Thought Is “I AM ŚIVA”, but Please Don’t Become Insufferable.
blocks.directed: Your New Thought Is “I AM ŚIVA”, but Please Don’t Become Insufferable.

blocks.text: Now this one’s particularly interesting because we’ve just spent half the text discussing how conceptual knowledge can constitute bondage.
blocks.directed: Now this one’s particularly interesting because we’ve just spent half the text discussing how conceptual knowledge can constitute bondage.

blocks.text: And suddenly Vasugupta says a form of reflective understanding is Self-knowledge.
blocks.directed: And suddenly Vasugupta says a form of reflective understanding is Self-knowledge.

blocks.text: WHAT?
blocks.directed: WHAT?

blocks.text: I thought thinking was the problem.
blocks.directed: I thought thinking was the problem.

blocks.text: Apparently we’re thinking again?
blocks.directed: Apparently we’re thinking again?

blocks.text: The crucial distinction concerns what the thinking reveals.
blocks.directed: The crucial distinction concerns what the thinking reveals.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja glosses vitarka here as the firm reflection:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Kṣemarāja glosses vitarka here as the firm reflection:

blocks.text: Viśvātmā śiva evāsmi.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Viśvātmā śiva evāsmi.

blocks.text: “I am indeed Śiva, whose Self is the universe.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am indeed Śiva, whose Self is the universe.”

blocks.text: This is Kṣemarāja’s explanatory Sanskrit, rather than an additional Śiva Sūtra. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: This is Kṣemarāja’s explanatory Sanskrit, rather than an additional Śiva Sūtra. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: The statement is extraordinary.
blocks.directed: The statement is extraordinary.

blocks.text: The limited person ordinarily thinks:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The limited person ordinarily thinks:

blocks.text: “I am this particular organism.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am this particular organism.”

blocks.text: “I am this mind.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am this mind.”

blocks.text: “I am separate from the rest of existence.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am separate from the rest of existence.”

blocks.text: But now understanding reverses the structure of identification.
blocks.directed: But now understanding reverses the structure of identification.

blocks.text: The yogi recognises their deepest identity with the consciousness whose manifestation is the universe.
blocks.directed: The yogi recognises their deepest identity with the consciousness whose manifestation is the universe.

blocks.text: And importantly, this does not license the individual ego to proclaim unlimited personal authority.
blocks.directed: And importantly, this does not license the individual ego to proclaim unlimited personal authority.

blocks.text: It isn’t:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It isn’t:

blocks.text: “My personal opinions are infallible because I’m God.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “My personal opinions are infallible because I’m God.”

blocks.text: That’s merely the old limited ego putting on a particularly extravagant crown.
blocks.directed: That’s merely the old limited ego putting on a particularly extravagant crown.

blocks.text: Rather, the point is that the fundamental subject is no longer mistaken for the contracted personality.
blocks.directed: Rather, the point is that the fundamental subject is no longer mistaken for the contracted personality.

blocks.text: The recognition is not the inflation of the little self.
blocks.directed: The recognition is not the inflation of the little self.

blocks.text: It is the recognition that the little self was never the complete Self.
blocks.directed: It is the recognition that the little self was never the complete Self.

blocks.text: And here’s the beautiful philosophical reversal.
blocks.directed: And here’s the beautiful philosophical reversal.

blocks.text: Earlier:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Earlier:

blocks.text: Jñānaṃ bandhaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Jñānaṃ bandhaḥ.

blocks.text: Knowledge is bondage.
blocks.directed: Knowledge is bondage.

blocks.text: Now:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now:

blocks.text: Vitarka ātmajñānam.
blocks.directed: Vitarka ātmajñānam.

blocks.text: A particular form of reflective understanding is knowledge of the Self.
blocks.directed: A particular form of reflective understanding is knowledge of the Self.

blocks.text: Knowledge that reinforces limitation binds; understanding that discloses one’s universal nature liberates.
blocks.directed: Knowledge that reinforces limitation binds; understanding that discloses one’s universal nature liberates.

blocks.text: Same broad territory of cognition.
blocks.directed: Same broad territory of cognition.

blocks.text: Completely different orientation.
blocks.directed: Completely different orientation.

blocks.text: It’s almost as though the problem wasn’t thinking.
blocks.directed: It’s almost as though the problem wasn’t thinking.

blocks.text: It was misunderstanding what you are.
blocks.directed: It was misunderstanding what you are.
